title: Architecture program ledger
notes: Module states are progress notes only (harness pruning, 2026-08-20): the state machine is no longer machine-validated. The chain legacy -> inventoried -> characterized -> guarded -> migrating -> strict remains as documentation of intent.
The remaining mechanical architecture checks: closed-world classification, module boundaries/entrypoints, single-writer invariants, webview manifest — see package.json test:architecture-policy.

Harness simplification (2026-08-19/20): the trusted kernel, dual approvals, CID, capability audit, and the ledger state machine were deleted. Harness changes are governed by the normal owner approval.
Architecture Change records are historical ADRs (ARCH-CHANGE-001 through 007 under docs/architecture/changes/). Machine authorization was deleted in PR #296; no future PR may consume them.
